CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.mark_conversation_read(p_conversation_id uuid, p_last_message_id uuid)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  v_actor uuid := (select auth.uid());
  v_target_sent_at timestamptz;
begin
  if v_actor is null
     or not (select private.has_module_access('chat', 'view', 'web'::public.platform_key))
     or not (select private.chat_is_active_member(p_conversation_id, v_actor)) then
    raise exception 'Chat read access denied' using errcode = '42501';
  end if;
  select message.sent_at into v_target_sent_at
  from public.chat_messages message
  where message.id = p_last_message_id and message.conversation_id = p_conversation_id;
  if v_target_sent_at is null then raise exception 'Message not found in conversation' using errcode = 'P0002'; end if;

  update public.chat_conversation_members member
  set last_read_message_id = p_last_message_id,
      last_read_at = greatest(coalesce(member.last_read_at, v_target_sent_at), v_target_sent_at),
      updated_at = now()
  where member.conversation_id = p_conversation_id
    and member.user_id = v_actor
    and (
      member.last_read_message_id is null
      or exists (
        select 1 from public.chat_messages previous
        where previous.id = member.last_read_message_id
          and (previous.sent_at, previous.id) <= (v_target_sent_at, p_last_message_id)
      )
    );

  insert into public.chat_message_reads (message_id, user_id, read_at)
  values (p_last_message_id, v_actor, now())
  on conflict (message_id, user_id) do nothing;
end;
$function$
